## US equity indices were mostly lower on Monday as higher oil prices consolidated the recent concerns of an incoming rate hike by the Federal Reserve. Contracts for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 fell up to 0.5%, while those for the Dow were marginally below the flatline. Wholesale prices for oil and products gained traction after the US and Iran delivered fresh strikes against each other. The developments followed their respective signals of blockades for tankers and vessels in the Persian Gulf, [...] the Persian Gulf, prolonging the suspension of exports from the region. Yields across the curve rose and equities for credit-sensitive sectors were under pressure. Microsoft, Palantir, Alphabet, and Tesla dropped up to 1% premarket.
